title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description: Req ID: 142868Remote Position: HybridRegion: AsiaCountry: IndiaState/Province: ChennaiCity: Guindy, ChennaiSummaryWe are seeking a strategic, deeply hands-on Senior Cloud & Platform Architect to lead both the architectural design and end-to-end operational lifecycle of our enterprise multi-cloud and container ecosystem. Reporting to the Head of Cloud Platform Services, you will bridge architecture and execution—defining target-state blueprints and governance standards across AWS, Azure, and GCP while actively deploying, managing, and maintaining mission-critical platforms.In this role, you will architect, build, and operate resilient multi-cluster Kubernetes platforms (native Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, GKE, and AKS), design and manage enterprise API integration patterns and service meshes, and engineer scalable infrastructure for high-throughput AI/ML inference and agentic workflows. You will serve as both a technical authority and a lead practitioner—mentoring Band 8 engineers, driving architectural reviews, and taking hands-on ownership of complex deployments, cluster lifecycle management, and high-severity incident resolutionDetailed DescriptionMulti-Cloud Architecture, Deployment & Management: Design, provision, and manage end-to-end multi-cloud reference architectures, landing zones, and hybrid connectivity patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP, balancing workload portability, resilience, and FinOps cost optimization.Kubernetes Platform Design & Lifecycle Operations: Architect, deploy, and maintain multi-tenant, multi-cluster Kubernetes environments (OpenShift, GKE, AKS, native K8s), overseeing cluster topology, GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), zero-downtime cluster upgrades, node pool patching, and resource auto-scaling (HPA, KEDA, Cluster Autoscaler).API Integration & Service Mesh Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise API integration patterns, API gateways, ingress controllers, and zero-trust service meshes (Istio) to secure and manage north-south and east-west service traffic.AI & Agentic Infrastructure Engineering & Support: Architect, deploy, and maintain low-latency infrastructure for LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and autonomous agentic runtimes—configuring GPU node pools, GPU slicing/scheduling, persistent storage, vector database integrations, and model-serving endpoints.Enterprise IaC & Automation: Establish organizational standards for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu,) while actively writing, testing, and maintaining reusable Terraform modules, Helm charts, Kustomize overlays, and custom operators.Security, Compliance & Vulnerability Management: Architect zero-trust security frameworks (IAM federation, workload identity, Vault) and oversee ongoing vulnerability management—driving remediation of container CVEs (Trivy, Grype) and enforcing security patches across cloud and cluster fleets.Backup, Disaster Recovery & Resilience: Define enterprise RTO/RPO tiers, architect multi-region active-active/active-passive failover strategies, manage automated backup tooling (Velero, Kasten), and lead periodic disaster recovery drills and chaos engineering exercises.Observability, Maintenance & Operational Excellence: Architect and maintain enterprise observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog/ELK), define Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and drive proactive health, hygiene, and capacity maintenance across environments.L2/L3 Escalation & Incident Remediation: Act as the senior technical escalation point (L3) while supporting complex L2 operational issues; lead live troubleshooting for systemic platform or pipeline failures, conduct blameless post-mortems, and engineer permanent architectural fixes.Knowledge/Skills/CompetenciesCloud Architecture & Operations: Deep architectural and hands-on administrative mastery across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and strong working knowledge of the third, including landing zones, transit networking, VPC/VNet management, IAM governance, and multi-region operations.Kubernetes & Container Ecosystems: Expert-level design, deployment, and day-2 operational experience across enterprise Kubernetes platforms (OpenShift, GKE, AKS, native K8s), including upgrades, patching, CNI plugins (Cilium, Calico), CSI storage drivers, and GitOps controllers.API Integration & Networking: Proven experience architecting, deploying, and troubleshooting enterprise API gateways, REST/gRPC/event-driven integration patterns (Kafka, EventBridge), service meshes (Istio/Linkerd), mTLS, OAuth2/OIDC, and DNS/BGP routing.AI/ML Infrastructure Management: Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting GPU cluster orchestration (NVIDIA GPU Operator, MIG), distributed storage, model-serving frameworks, and sandboxed runtimes for agentic AI workflows.Infrastructure as Code & Scripting: Mastery of modular Terraform/OpenTofu, Helm, Kustomize with strong proficiency in Go, Python, or Bash for building custom operators and operational automation.Observability, Security & DR Tooling: Extensive hands-on experience configuring and maintaining Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, container vulnerability scanners (Trivy/Grype), and Kubernetes backup/restore solutions (Velero/Kasten).Preferred CertificationsKubernetes: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) alongside Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).Cloud Architecture (Professional Level): AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.Physical DemandsDuties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.Typical ExperienceExperience: 10+years of overall work experience, 8+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in cloud engineering, platform operations, and systems architecture, including at least 3 years in a lead or architectural role responsible for both designing and running production multi-cloud and Kubernetes environments.Operational & Architectural Balance: Proven track record of owning the full lifecycle of enterprise platforms—from initial Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and greenfield deployment through day-2 maintenance, patching, and high-stakes incident resolution.Typical EducationBachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience. title: Cloud Infrastructure and Kubernetes Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Solverines Technology Solutions is a technology company delivering web and mobile solutions using the OutSystems Platform and Microsoft technologies. Our team specializes in the implementation, support and maintenance of enterprise-grade applications, providing reliable services within agreed timelines and budgets.

We partner closely with clients, combining transparent communication, seamless collaboration, and deep technical expertise to help organizations improve productivity, efficiency, and overall business performance. Through our unique approach—the Solverines Way—we innovate, collaborate and deliver value while staying true to our core values, business ethics and commitment to excellence.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a skilled
**Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes Engineer**

to design, deploy, manage, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in DevOps cloud platforms, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), containerization, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD pipelines, along with strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of cloud security, networking, monitoring, and performance optimization would be an added advantage.
Capable of independently managing cloud infrastructure, setting up Kubernetes clusters, deploying applications, troubleshooting pod failures and maintaining production environments.

Key Responsibilites:

**Cloud Infrastructure & Management**

·      Design, deploy, configure, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure.

·      Experience with Prometheus, Grafana and CloudWatch.

·      Manage cloud environments across platforms such as Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

·      Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, resource utilization, and system health.

·      Implement cloud security practices, access controls, networking, backup, and disaster recovery measures.

·      Identify infrastructure issues, troubleshoot incidents, and ensure system reliability and performance.

**Kubernetes & DevOps Engineering**

·      Deploy, manage, and maintain containerized applications using Kubernetes.

·      Demonstrate hands-on expertise in
**Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)**
.

·      Manage Kubernetes clusters, nodes, pods, deployments, services, configurations and issue resolution.

·      Work with Docker and containerization technologies to streamline application deployment along with Linux Administration and Shell Scripting.

·      Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate build, testing, deployment, and release processes.

·      Implement infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm

or equivalent technologies.

·      Configure monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure optimal application and infrastructure performance.

·      Perform capacity planning, scaling, upgrades, and routine maintenance of cloud and Kubernetes environments.

**Collaboration & Ownership**

·      Collaborate with development, DevOps and other technical teams to ensure seamless application deployment and infrastructure operations.

·      Work independently, take ownership of assigned deliverables, and proactively resolve technical challenges.

·      Follow industry best practices for cloud architecture, security, automation, and infrastructure management.

·      Maintain technical documentation and actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

·      Provide technical support and guidance to internal teams and stakeholders when required.

Requirements and Qualifications:

·      Bachelor's degree (B.E., B.Tech, B.Sc, or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cloud Computing or a related field.

·      2 - 5 years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes administration, DevOps or a related role.

·      Capable of independently managing cloud infrastructure, setting up Kubernetes clusters, deploying applications, troubleshooting pod failures and maintaining production environments.

·      Strong knowledge and practical experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and AWS.

·      Hands-on expertise in
**Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)**
and
**Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)**
.

·      Proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker, container orchestration, and microservices architecture.

·      Experience with Prometheus, Grafana and CloudWatch.

·      Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

·      Knowledge of cloud networking, security, access management, monitoring, and performance optimization.

·      Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

·      Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

·      Ability to manage infrastructure deployments, resolve technical issues, and ensure system reliability.

·      Good communication, documentation, collaboration, and time-management skills.

·      Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced technical environment.

·      Relevant certifications such as
**CKA, CKAD, Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or AWS Certified Solutions Architect**
would be an added advantage.

📩
**Interested?**
Apply directly or share your CV to sana.khan@solverines.com

title: AI and Agent Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior AI and Agent Engineer will develop, integrate, test, deploy, and monitor AI-enabled applications and agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. The role is responsible for the intelligence, orchestration, actions, integrations, and behavioral quality of AI solutions.
  
  
This is an AI application engineering role, not a prompt-writing position. The successful candidate must be able to build production software, integrate enterprise systems, create evaluation frameworks, troubleshoot complex behavior, and operate deployed solutions.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**AI and agent development**

* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, triggers, workflows, and generative orchestration.
* Develop AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure services.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, multistep orchestration, and human approval patterns.
* Develop custom APIs, Azure Functions, connectors, and supporting application services.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Power Platform, and approved enterprise systems.

**Prompt, context, and behavior engineering**

* Develop system instructions, prompts, grounding logic, response structures, fallback behavior, and escalation rules.
* Implement model selection and routing based on accuracy, risk, latency, and consumption requirements.
* Design agent behavior that distinguishes between answering, recommending, requesting clarification, escalating, and taking action.
* Maintain version control for prompts, instructions, tools, actions, and model configurations.

**Testing and evaluation**

* Develop evaluation datasets with practice SMEs.
* Automate tests for groundedness, relevance, completeness, citation quality, task completion, response consistency, and escalation behavior.
* Perform adversarial testing involving prompt injection, data leakage, unsupported instructions, excessive agency, and unauthorized actions.
* Build regression tests to detect changes caused by models, prompts, source content, integrations, or application releases.
* Document known limitations and expected failure behavior.

**Operations and improvement**

* Instrument solutions for usage, latency, failures, cost, task completion, user feedback, and model behavior.
* Review production telemetry and interaction patterns.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective changes.
* Optimize token consumption, retrieval performance, application latency, and integration reliability.
* Develop reusable agent templates, integration components, evaluation harnesses, and error-handling patterns.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python development skills.
* TypeScript or JavaScript development experience.
* REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, OpenAPI, webhooks, and event-driven integration.
* Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
* Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams integration.
* Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and structured generation.
* Agent orchestration, state management, tool invocation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Automated testing, Git, pull requests, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
* Understanding of prompt injection, data exfiltration, overreliance, hallucination, unsafe actions, and AI-specific failure modes.

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 or more years of software, integration, automation, or data application development.
* Demonstrated production experience with generative AI or conversational AI applications.
* Experience building applications across Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Familiarity with Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Basic C# experience within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.

**Success Measures**

* Evaluation performance against approved acceptance thresholds.
* Task-completion and appropriate-escalation rates.
* Production defect and regression rates.
* Retrieval and grounding quality.
* Response latency and cost per transaction.
* Integration reliability.
* Reuse of standard components.
* Completeness of technical documentation and automated testing.
* Speed and effectiveness of incident remediation.

**Role Boundaries**
This role engineers the behavior of AI applications. Practice SMEs remain accountable for defining and validating authoritative professional content, business rules, acceptable conclusions, and circumstances requiring human review.
